The policeman edge of the vomer, which appears a
bove the back-part of the palate-bones, is broader above;
but as it defends forwards, because thinner, though it
is fulfill faith and firm.—The lower edge of this bone,
which refs on the nafal spine of the palate and maxil-
hy bones, has a little throw on each fide, of a final
middle ridge... enforcing to the future of the bones of
different fides, and the interfice between them. This
edge and the upper one meet in the pointed fore-end of
this bone.
